test.command: cd backend && mvn test && cd frontend && npm test

appliedUpdates.description: Added timezone-safe frontend LocalDate formatting guidance to .factory/library/architecture.md (avoid `new Date(YYYY-MM-DD)` parsing).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify TDD expectations for verification/audit-only features and require explicit deviation reporting when tests-first is intentionally skipped.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both categories-backend-api and categories-transactions-authorization reviews observed mismatch between strict tests-first wording and actual execution while handoffs marked followedProcedure=true.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a concise Spring Boot 4 + Jackson 3 test guidance note (ObjectMapper usage/config) to reduce avoidable setup confusion.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: categories-backend-api review captured explicit handoff feedback that Jackson 3.x differences caused test implementation churn.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document jsdom responsive-render caveat (multiple breakpoint branches can coexist in tests) and recommended query/assertion patterns.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: transactions-frontend-ui review found custom helper assertions were needed because mobile and desktop text nodes can coexist in Vitest/jsdom.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify when agent-browser/manual checks and shared-library updates are mandatory vs optional for narrowly scoped UI/utility fixes, and require explicit deviation logging when skipped.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both transactions-frontend-ui and fix-timezone-date-formatting workers completed without agent-browser calls or library updates while marking followedProcedure=true.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a guidance check to keep generated feature expectedBehavior aligned with the actual API surface to avoid acceptance ambiguity.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: categories-transactions-authorization review noted expected behavior referenced GET-by-id checks not present in current category/transaction controllers.

rejectedObservations.observation: Frontend typecheck command mismatch in services.yaml.
Document backend error payload fallback (`error` vs `message`) in shared library immediately.
Repeated reports about backend tests-first mismatch.
